what: Traffic ranking claims interleaved RM sticks cannot be coalesced (consecutive sticks in different banks). But sticks p, p+num_banks, ... are contiguous inside one bank, so a tile-row reads as num_banks wide reads plus local reorder copies; this was the 2-3x lever on the perf-focus shapes.
suggest: Planner/catalog read_coalescing entry: note same-bank stride coalescing for interleaved RM sources (stride = num_banks pages), not only for sharded shard rows.
